acceptanceCriteria: The shadow source pin is advanced to a commit containing V1-1373 (or a documented rule keeps it current), with owner consent recorded on the PR.
body: From V1-1257 lane (PR #988). The hosted shadow builds corvint from 5163d1ed (before V1-1373's shell-test declaration). Low impact: the shadow reads the declaration from the tested checkout. Bumping the pin is a .github/ change and needs owner AFP-V0-016 consent.
title: ci shadow: CORVINT_TEST_SHADOW_SOURCE still pinned to 5163d1ed, which predates V1-1373
